column3: Close to the Hebrew; “to kill” is rendered “to put … to death.”
“Take care” is rendered “be on guard,” and “hiding place” as “secret place.”
“I will see whatever” is rendered “if I find out anything.”
“Spoke good of David” is rendered “spoke well of David”; “good for you” becomes “beneficial to you.”
“Put his life in his palm” is rendered “took his life in his hand.”
“Swore an oath” is rendered “vowed,” and the oath form “if he will be put to death” as “he shall not be put to death.”
“As yesterday three days ago” is rendered “as formerly.”
“A spirit of the LORD, evil” is rendered “an evil spirit from the LORD.”
“Strike with the spear on David and on the wall” is rendered “pin David to the wall with the spear.”
“The teraphim” is rendered “the household idol,” and “the garment” as “clothes.”
“He saw” (singular in Hebrew) is rendered “they saw”; “standing chief over them” becomes “standing and presiding over them.”
